text:
A catheter valve is unsuitable when the bladder cannot safely store urine, including limited capacity, detrusor overactivity, ureteric reflux, renal impairment, or absent filling sensation. It is also unsuitable when the person or a carer cannot open it reliably every few hours because of cognitive impairment or poor manual dexterity, and when recent bladder or urethral surgery requires continuous free drainage. Those patients need continuous drainage into a bag.
